title: API reference
description: The HTTP interface for your self-hosted storage, file management, and public links.

sections.title: Base URL and authentication
paragraphs: Use your API origin, locally http://127.0.0.1:8787. The examples use LOFT_API and LOFT_TOKEN environment variables. /v1 endpoints require a bearer token; /health is public.

sections.title: Files and content
paragraphs: File IDs identify objects independently of their display names. Uploads can supply X-Loft-Name, X-Loft-Folder, and Content-Type headers.

sections.title: Sharing endpoints
paragraphs: The operator issues and revokes records; recipients use those issued links.

sections.title: Health check
paragraphs: GET /health returns a JSON object with ok: true when the process handles the request. It is a liveness check, not a full backup or storage-integrity check.
